hypotheses.title: Zero NeuralSearch — NLP queries completely fail
hypotheses.evidence: 'gift for her under 100' returns 3,229 results led by an Under Armour backpack — price cap ignored, gender intent not understood.
hypotheses.tied_to: CEO Doug Howe's stated mandate to “elevate our customers’ omnichannel experience” (FY2024 earnings release, Mar 2025) — this finding is the gap behind that mandate.
hypotheses.confidence_risk_note: EMPTY SLOT — this audit's data pipeline does not yet compute a Discovery-OS confidence / risk-if-wrong score per finding (that scoring layer is designed, not built — see PRISM-V2 Track G-schema). Severity shown above is the real field the pipeline does produce; it is not a substitute for confidence/risk and is labeled as such to avoid misrepresenting one field as another.

hypotheses.title: No federated search — content & loyalty invisible
hypotheses.evidence: Typing 'rewards' or searching mid-catalog surfaces 12 query completions and 10 product thumbnails only — no loyalty program page, no help content, no brand editorial.
hypotheses.tied_to: CMO Sarah Crockett on app/loyalty engagement (“Our top customers shop both channels... they engage with our app very regularly,” Marketing Dive, Jan 2025) — loyalty is invisible in the exact channel she's describing.
hypotheses.confidence_risk_note: EMPTY SLOT — same pipeline gap as above; no confidence/risk score computed yet.

hypotheses.title: No personalized search ranking
hypotheses.evidence: 6,519 sneaker results shown in identical generic rank order to every visitor — a VIP Insider Gold member with a known size/brand history sees the same list as a first-time guest.
hypotheses.tied_to: Company priority “VIP loyalty program relaunch” (icp_mapping, sourced from CMO quote above) — personalization is the stated loyalty lever with zero implementation found.
hypotheses.confidence_risk_note: EMPTY SLOT — same pipeline gap as above; no confidence/risk score computed yet.

competitive_objection.objection: “We have an internal search solution that works.”
competitive_objection.response: Network inspection confirmed zero enterprise search vendor — dsw.com runs a custom/proprietary backend. 'Gift for her under $100' returning an Under Armour backpack at position #1 is the gap that backend produces. Shoe Carnival ran a similar in-house setup before switching to Algolia and saw a 3.5x conversion increase.
competitive_objection.source: hiring.objection_counters[0], generate-audit-data.py synthesis grounded in tech_stack network inspection (builtwith.com/dsw.com) + Shoe Carnival case study
